title: Binance Says It Has Fully Covered the $6.34 Billion Hack With Company Funds
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Binance Says It Has Fully Covered the $6.34 Billion Hack With Company Funds

The exchange says users are whole after the Oct. 29 theft, paid for from SAFU, its futures insurance fund and treasury, and has published a 198-token proof-of-reserves snapshot that users cannot yet independently verify.

This post Binance Says It Has Fully Covered the $6.34 Billion Hack With Company Funds first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

title: JPMorgan Lifts Its Strategy (MSTR) Stake 36% and Holds $540 Million in Bitcoin ETFs
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

JPMorgan Lifts Its Strategy (MSTR) Stake 36% and Holds $540 Million in Bitcoin ETFs

A 13F filed Thursday shows JPMorgan held 848,932 Strategy shares, up 36% from June, and 11.4 million IBIT shares worth $540 million at Sept. 30, weeks before MSCI's index exit.

This post JPMorgan Lifts Its Strategy (MSTR) Stake 36% and Holds $540 Million in Bitcoin ETFs first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.
